name: Exception Mailer
description: A basic module to send email when an error/exception occurs.
project_description:
INTRODUCTION 
 The Error & Exception Mailer module sends an email when error/exception occurs.

 FEATURES 
 Flood protection : Comes with email flood control out-of-the-box. Your inbox won't get full of the same repeated error messages.

 Filters : you can exclude certain errors you decide to ignore.

 CONFIGURATION 
 Administration » Development » Exception mailer config:

 
 Enable/disable sending emails 
 Customize which role(s) (users assigned to role(s)) should get email or add specific email recipients. 
 Set on which Error level type (critical, error, warning, etc) should be email sent 
 Excludes - add exclude definitions to don't send email in specific cases 
 Flood protection - customize the default flood control if you want 
 Back to top
